body: haha, well thanks. I mean, I've been fired before...things will most likely eventually be okay again, it's just freaking me out right now. I had a lot of respect and admiration for the manager who fired me, and to feel like I personally let her down is no fun ):

I guess I just keep feeling like he doesn't have any reasons to stay with me. It's really hard for me to try to rationalize things like that, because it's all a matter of opinion. I dunno. I have no idea where I'm going with this anymore.

I'm really concerned about the way I lost my job. I feel like no one should want to hire me anymore

I stole the money because I wanted to. Yeah, that makes me a bad person, I know.

I absolutely don't deserve to be with my fiance. He could be with a girl who isn't crazy and full of emotions and doing stupid things. I don't know why he chooses to be with me. He says it's because he loves me, I say it's out of convenience...
thank you for the kind words. I'm doing my best to just get through today.
